jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Sr.  Medical Transcriptionist/ Medical Scribe (Full Time) (Night Shift) We are currently seeking experienced candidates to join our team as Sr.
jobs.description:
Job Description: Sr. Medical Transcriptionist/ Medical Scribe (Full Time) (Night Shift)

We are currently seeking experienced candidates to join our team as Sr. Medical Transcriptionists/Medical Scribes in a full-time position with night shift hours. This role involves working closely with leading radiologists in the USA, transcribing live and offline dictations across different modalities such as X-ray, CT, Ultrasound, and more. The primary responsibility is to accurately transcribe dictations, prepare reports, and assist radiologists in completing error-free reports.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Transcribe dictations: Listen to radiology dictations and accurately transcribe them into written reports, ensuring precision and clarity in the documentation of medical information.
  • Collaborate with Radiologists: Work alongside radiologists in a live environment, assisting them during procedures and documenting findings in real-time.
  • Offline transcription: Transcribe dictations from audio recordings outside of live settings, taking full responsibility for delivering accurate and timely transcriptions.
  • Prepare reports: Utilize transcribed information to prepare concise and comprehensive reports, maintaining formatting and adhering to specific guidelines.
  • Maintain speed and accuracy: Demonstrate excellent typing skills with a minimum speed of 30 words per minute (WPM) to ensure efficiency in transcribing dictations and report generation.
  • Night shift availability: Exhibit flexibility and willingness to work night shifts in alignment with our operations.
  • Strong communication skills: Possess effective written and spoken communication skills to collaborate with radiologists and other team members, ensuring clear and accurate documentation.
  • Basic computer skills: Utilize computers and relevant software systems efficiently to manage and organize medical records, transcriptions, and reports.
  • Ability to work as a team: Collaborate effectively with the healthcare team, supporting and assisting colleagues to ensure smooth and error-free operations.
  • Continuous learning: Show enthusiasm for learning and adapting to evolving technologies, medical procedures, and guidelines.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription.
  • Medical transcription certification or prior experience in the field is highly desirable.
  • Good communication skills, both written and spoken, to effectively interact with radiologists and team members.
  • Strong listening skills to accurately transcribe dictations and capture essential details.
  • Typing speed of over 30 words per minute (WPM).
  • Comfortable working night shifts in alignment with our operational requirements.
  • Basic computer skills, including proficiency in relevant software applications for documentation and record management.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well in a team environment and contribute collaboratively.
  • Immediate availability for joining.
  • Virtual interview process will be conducted.

If you possess a minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription, have excellent communication and listening skills, and are ready to work night shifts, we encourage you to apply for this challenging and rewarding position. Join our dedicated team and work closely with leading radiologists in the USA, contributing to the accurate and efficient generation of medical reports.

jobs.excerpt: Learning Administrator (LMS Administrator) Location: Remote Experience: 2+ Years Employment Type: Full-TimeShift timing: 10pm to 7am (Night Shift)About the RoleWe are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Learning Administrator to support the day-to-day administration of our Learning Management System (LMS) and training operations.
jobs.description:
Learning Administrator (LMS Administrator)

Location: Remote

Experience: 2+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Shift timing: 10pm to 7am (Night Shift)

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Learning Administrator to support the day-to-day administration of our Learning Management System (LMS) and training operations. This role will be responsible for coordinating learning activities, managing training sessions, supporting learners and stakeholders, handling reporting requests, and ensuring seamless training logistics.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on LMS administration experience, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

LMS Administration

  • Create, update, and deactivate learning activities and training plans.
  • Maintain course catalogues and learning content.
  • Manage learner assignments and enrolments.
  • Support learning activity lifecycle management.

Training Coordination & Session Management

  • Schedule instructor-led training programs and sessions.
  • Coordinate instructor, classroom, and location requirements.
  • Manage registrations, waitlists, cancellations, and roster updates.
  • Process batch enrolments and learner substitutions.
  • Ensure accurate attendance and completion tracking.

Reporting & Access Management

  • Support LMS access and role requests.
  • Generate standard and ad hoc reports.
  • Assist stakeholders with learning-related inquiries.
  • Manage reporting requests and maintain data accuracy.

Learner & Stakeholder Support

  • Respond to learner and business user inquiries via email and ticketing systems (ServiceNow preferred).
  • Resolve LMS-related issues and training coordination requests.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service to internal stakeholders.

Training Logistics

  • Coordinate training materials and supplies.
  • Manage training-related documentation and certificates.
  • Support classroom setup and logistics.
  • Coordinate training evaluations and reporting.
  • Assist with catering, shipping, and administrative support for training events.

System Monitoring

  • Monitor document loader activity and transaction logs.
  • Investigate and resolve processing errors.
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with established procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in LMS Administration, Learning Coordination, or Training Operations.
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS).
  • Experience supporting instructor-led and virtual learning programs.
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • High level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with LMS platforms such as:
    • SumTotal
    • Cornerstone OnDemand
    • SAP SuccessFactors Learning
    • Saba
    • Workday Learning
    • Oracle Learning Management
  • Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems.
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-driven environments.
